tasks.label: Build & Run Tests
tasks.command: cmake -B build -S . && cmake --build build && ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure

tasks.label: Show Coverage Report
tasks.command: cmake --build build --target coverage && xdg-open ./build/coverage.html 2>/dev/null || explorer.exe ./build/coverage.html 2>/dev/null || echo 'Open build/coverage.html in your browser'

tasks.label: Install toolchain
tasks.command: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install cmake ninja-build cppcheck gcovr -y
